title: Repo renamed am-mini-docling -> extrct_docling
summary: Folder and GitHub repo renamed; fixed the fallout (remote URL, venv script shebangs, editable install, worktree paths, stale .pyc co_filename) and the docs.

title: Standalone <stem>.html built on Docling's HTML serializer
summary: Chose to extend docling-core's HTMLDocSerializer (merged-cell tables, captions, formulas) over a custom renderer; added per-block provenance attributes and a JSON manifest for agents.

title: .claude/hooks/lib was never committed
summary: Upstream .gitignore ignores every [Ll]ib folder, so 5 of 6 project hooks crashed on import in fresh clones; re-included with a negation rule and verified from a git archive export.

title: Showcase paper kept in full under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0
summary: Added showcase/LICENSE (the repo MIT does not cover it); rejected a page excerpt or a CC BY replacement because the license already allows sharing in whole or part and the paper is in public history.

title: Noise filter hid real echo frames; imaging veto added
summary: Labelled all 68 classifier-hidden pictures in 37 papers by eye: only 6 echo frames were content. A BiomedCLIP imaging type at >= 0.9 (ecg and nuclear_medicine excluded) un-hides exactly those 6 and none of 62 badges/logos.

title: <stem>.html made a full ingestion of the PDF
summary: Docling's serializer left out 7,458 of 10,940 items on 18 papers (figure-internal text, furniture, noise pictures, floating-item footnotes); all are now kept and marked, plus list markers and undecoded formula text. Checked by item coverage (0 missing) and PDF text-layer word recall.

title: Ligature-split words rejoined against the PDF text layer
summary: docling-parse wrote words like 'speci fi city' in 2 of 18 papers; text_repair.py rejoins a split only into a word pdfium reads on the same page, before every export.

title: Granite-Vision table generation had no length limit
summary: max_new_tokens was the tokenizer's unset model_max_length (~1e30); a supplement of boxed prompts read as tables generated for 75+ min with GPU memory climbing 17 -> 57 GB. Capped at max(2048, 3 x crop PDF-text tokens + 512); no real table of 88 came near it.

title: Tables keep their box's PDF text when model cells miss words
summary: Granite-Vision retypes cell text from the image; when cells hold < 95% of the words printed in the box, the PDF text is stored (amir__pdf_text) and shown in the HTML with data-cell-text-recall.

title: Releases named extrct_docling-v<docling version>-r<n>
summary: Replaced the short-lived extrct-v1.0.x tags (deleted on request): tag = fork + upstream Docling base + fork revision; ENGINE_VERSION and run.json engine block (version, git commit, dirty flag) match it. No GitHub Release page: upstream's pypi.yml would fire on the fork.

title: release-tag skill with a sensitive-content scan
summary: Codified the release ritual (version, docs, gates, tag, push only on request) and check_sensitive.sh, which fails a push on never-push files, token patterns, machine paths, username, hostname or private IPs.

title: Releases extrct_docling-v2.131.0-r1 and -r2
summary: r1 (8dd6e035): everything above. r2 (edb3d3a8): HTML keeps captions/footnotes of code blocks (Docling's HTML code serializer drops them) and records html_written_by. Both tags pushed; no workflow ran.

title: 23 sample PDFs converted from r1, HTML written by r2
summary: 4 + 14 papers and 5 supplements: all SUCCESS in one pass, 0 errors; item coverage 0 missing of 12,692; PDF text-layer word recall 99.60-99.82% per batch. HTML regenerated from bundles with r2 (conversion unchanged); outputs are git-ignored under samples/.

title: Adopted the /project-memory ritual from dot-claude-iff
summary: Skill (user-only), CHECK script, retro-analyst agent, push knob, and a UserPromptSubmit hook minting the ritual ticket (approved into hooks.lock); STATUS.md, Project-log.jsonl and LESSONS.jsonl replace AMIR_STAGE's log from here on.

title: Export check scripts were scratch-only and are gone
summary: Item coverage, PDF text-layer recall and the batch watcher lived in the session scratchpad, deleted at the user's request; folding them into amir-batch is the top next step.
